name: ux2-u16-formcss
prompt:
Write public/css/ux2-forms.css (new file, about 70 lines): STU-UX2 form styles, loaded after style.css, ux1.css and ux1-cards.css. style.css (loaded first) defines these custom properties, use them: --bg, --surface, --surface-2, --surface-3, --text, --text-2, --accent (orange on dark, orange-ink #8a5a00 on light), --accent-hover, --active-bg, --active-text, --border, --input-bg, --danger, --shadow, --radius (10px), --radius-sm (6px), --white, --mist, --plum, --orange, --orange-light, --orange-ink; ux1.css adds --space-1 8px, --space-2 16px, --space-3 24px, --text-xs 12px, --text-sm 13px, --text-md 15px, --text-lg 18px, --radius-card 12px, --shadow-card, --motion 170ms. Dark is the default; light comes from prefers-color-scheme in style.css, so never hard-code text colours on themed surfaces (the header is purple in both themes). Motion only on transform and opacity (170 ms), never transition colours or borders; respect prefers-reduced-motion. Text needs WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) in both themes.
1. fieldset.field-group: no border, no default margin/padding (border 0; margin 0; padding 0; min-width 0), display grid, gap 10px. Its legend: padding 0, margin-bottom 8px, --text-xs, weight 700, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em, color var(--text-2).
2. The image form's fieldsets read as groups: `#generate-form > fieldset.field-group + fieldset.field-group` gets padding-top 16px and border-top 1px solid var(--border).
3. Inline help: `.field-hint` margin-top -2px, line-height 1.4.
4. Validation: `.field-error` color var(--danger), --text-sm, weight 600, display flex, align-items center, gap 6px, with a ::before of content '!' in a 16 px round badge (background var(--danger), color var(--surface), font-size 11px, weight 800, grid centred, flex none). `[aria-invalid="true"]` gets border-color var(--danger) and `[aria-invalid="true"]:focus` outline-color var(--danger).
5. Segmented control: `.segmented` display inline-flex, flex-wrap wrap, gap 2px, padding 3px, radius 999px, background var(--surface-2), border 1px solid var(--border), max-width 100%. `.seg-btn`: font inherit, --text-sm, weight 600, padding 6px 14px, border 0, radius 999px, background transparent, color var(--text-2), cursor pointer, transition transform 170ms; hover color var(--text); :active scale(0.97); `.seg-btn[aria-checked="true"]` background var(--active-bg), color var(--active-text), box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent). `.seg-btn:focus-visible` outline 2px solid var(--accent), outline-offset 2px.
6. The size buttons (`.size-toggles`) look the same: display inline-flex, gap 2px, padding 3px, radius 999px, background var(--surface-2), border 1px solid var(--border); `.size-toggles .size-btn` border-color transparent, radius 999px, background transparent; `.size-toggles .size-btn.active` background var(--active-bg), color var(--active-text), box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent).
7. Collapsible Advanced: `.advanced > summary` min-height 44px, display flex, align-items center; `.advanced[open] > .advanced-body` animation of opacity 0 and translateY(-4px) to normal over 170ms.
8. @media (max-width: 600px): `.input-group-row` one column.
9. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): `.seg-btn` transition none and transform none; `.advanced[open] > .advanced-body` animation none.
Output only the file.
